button.label: Voice input
button.hint: Hold to talk, slide up to cancel

permission.title: Allow Multica to use the microphone?
permission.body: Speech is turned into text by iOS dictation and inserted into the composer. Audio is not uploaded to Multica servers.
permission.denied_body: Allow Microphone and Speech Recognition for Multica in Settings, then come back.
